Commentary.Commentary: The chase is set to begin. Australia Women stride out to the middle. Followed by the opening pair of India Women, Shafali Verma and Smriti Mandhana. Tayla Vlaeminck to start with the ball.
... The Run Chase ...

Now then, the target is a stiff one! The wicket does have something in it for the bowlers but still a decent one to bat on. The dew also might come into play later on. Have to say a lot will depend on how the Indian openers begin with. Australia, on the other hand, will know they need early wickets, India bat deep and if they do not manage to take wickets, it could be one way traffic. Join us for the second essay in a bit.

India bowled well for most of the parts! They would be a tad disappointed with the final five but overall will be very pleased with the effort with the ball and in the field too. It was Shikha Pandey and Renuka Singh who were really good with the new ball. Pooja Vastrakar continued her good form and so did Rajeshwari Gayakwad and Deepti Sharma. At one stage, it seemed like India would keep Australia under the 140-run mark but they could not stem the run-flow towards the end.

A strong finish then from the Aussies has seen them reach the 150-run mark! However, not sure which side will be the happier of the two at the moment. Probably both will be satisfied. Australia, especially after the struggle they have gone through in this innings. They were reeling at 73 for 4 as Mooney once again saw wickets falling at the other end. She though held fort at one end and scored a lovely half ton. It was once again her stand with Tahlia McGrath who bailed Australia out of trouble.

NOT OUT! Australia do get the two runs in the end. Full and down leg. Wareham follows the line of the delivery and whips it through mid-wicket. They decide to take two. The fielder in the deep collects the ball and throw's it at the bowler's end. The stumps were disturbed, but not sure if it was the ball. The umpire takes it upstairs. The replays roll in to show Deepti Sharma did not collect the ball and hit the stumps with her hands. The final decision is not out. AUSTRALIA WOMEN END THEIR INNINGS AT 149/5.
A run out appeal and it is referred. Seems out. Has she hit the stumps with her hand?
Fuller and on middle. McGrath whips it to mid on for a single.
Full and on the pads. Wareham tucks it to wide long on for a single.
FOUR! Up and over! Full and on off. Wareham makes room and lifts it over mid off. The ball races away to the boundary.
Tossed up, on middle. McGrath pushes it to point for a single.
Full and on off. Wareham pushes it to mid off and takes off for a single.
FOUR! SMACKED! Full-length ball, outside off. McGrath hangs back and slaps it through backward point for a boundary.
A length ball, on off. Wareham works it through mid-wicket for a single.

Brilliant from Jemimah Rodrigues in the deep! Fuller and on off. Georgia Wareham pushes it through point. Jemimah Rodrigues covers a lot of ground to her left, puts in a dive and saves a certain boundary. They take two.

That must've hurt. Fuller and outside off. Tahlia McGrath pushes it to mid off. They decide to take one. The fielder collects the ball and has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. The ball though goes onto hit Pandey on her calfs.
Slower, length ball, outside off. Wareham slaps it to cover but straight to the fielder. They take one.
Full toss and on middle. McGrath flicks it through square leg for a single.
Shikha Pandey is back now!
Flatter and on off. Tahlia McGrath pushes it through covers for a single.
FOUR! Tahlia McGrath is in her groove now. Full and outside off. Tahlia McGrath gets low and slog-sweeps it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
SIX! All the way! Tossed up, on off. Tahlia McGrath skips down the track and smokes it over the bowler's head for a maximum.
Short and on off. Georgia Wareham pulls it to long on for a single.

OUT! CAUGHT! Beth Mooney has to depart on 61. This was a top catch from Harmanpreet Kaur. Floated, full and outside off. Mooney gets under it and lifts it towards cover. The ball stays low though. Harmanpreet Kaur dives in front and take a one-handed catch with her left. This is what India Women were looking for.
Commentary.Howout: c Harmanpreet Kaur b Rajeshwari Gayakwad

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Perfect placement. Mooney is on a roll. Floated, full and on off. Mooney flicks it through mid-wicket. It disects the fielders in the deep and the ball ends up in the boundary.
FOUR! Finally Tahlia McGrath connects and gets a boundary off it. A length ball, outside off. Tahlia McGrath comes across and punches it through point. The ball races away to the fence.
Another swing and a miss! This is clever from Pooja Vastrakar. She serves it full and outside off. Tahlia McGrath looks to chase it but misses.
Another miss for Tahlia McGrath. Pooja Vastrakar serves it full and wide outside off. McGrath looks to heave it away but misses.
Swing and a miss! Good-length ball, outside off. Tahlia McGrath looks to cut it away but misses.
Full-length ball, outside off. Tahlia McGrath looks to chase it but misses.
FOUR! Up and over! Good length ball, on middle. McGrath makes room and lifts it over mid off for a boundary.
Floated, full and outside off. Mooney looks to sweep it away but misses. Just 6 runs off it.
FOUR! Nicely played. Full and on off. Mooney reverse sweeps it towards third man and gets a boundary.
On off, kept out.
Full and on off. McGrath works it to long on for a single.
Flatter and on off. McGrath pushes it to mid off.
Floated, outside off. Mooney pushes it to cover for a single.

FOUR! Lovely placement! Two boundaries in the over then! Tahlia McGrath is all set to launch now. End of a good over. One which could well shift the momentum now. Outside off, this is driven through covers. Once again beats the fielder in the deep. Boundary.
A good slower one outside off, Tahlia McGrath looks to cut but is beaten.
Fuller and on off, this is pushed down to long off for one.

FOUR! Fifty up in style for Mooney! She continues this brilliant series for her. Mooney is a banker for Australia, isn't she? Very dependable and secure. It is like we almost know what we are going to get from her. Fuller and outside off, this is driven past cover and into the fence. She has more than half of the runs so far.
Fuller and outside off, Tahlia McGrath looks to drive it through the off side, this goes off the inner half through mid on for one.
Attacks the stumps, Tahlia McGrath pushes it to covers.
So despite the boundary, only 7 from the over. Outside off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Comes down the track now and then tries to hit it past cover. Does not beat Kaur there.
FOUR! Really nicely played! She had to get bat to that! On middle, Tahlia McGrath brings the sweep out, she hits it through square leg. Welcome boundary.
This time really hits it well, through square leg for one.
Brings the sweep out, it is on her pads, finds short fine leg.
Shorter and on off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Angled into the pads, this is worked through square leg for one more. Tidy from Renuka.
Just another one! Outside off, Mooney guides it down to third man and gets to the other end.
Another single! On off, Tahlia McGrath pushes it through covers for one more.
On off, Tahlia McGrath pushes it to covers.
Just the one again! Very short and very wide outside off, it is guided down to third man for one.
On the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
Renuka Singh is back into the attack.
Outside off, Tahlia McGrath drags it through mid-wicket and takes one more. End of a really good over from Sharma.
A low full toss, this is hit down to long off for one.
Another one! On middle, this is pushed down to long on for one. Tahlia McGrath is off the mark.
Tossed up on middle, this is pushed back to the bowler.
Outside off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Tahlia McGrath walks out now.

OUT! TAKEN! Perry now has to walk back and Australia in trouble. First real sign of aggression and that proves to be her downfall. Good catch from Pooja Vastrakar! This is tossed up on off, Perry comes down the track and lofts it towards long on. Pooja Vastrakar runs to her left and takes a good catch. Replays just showed, it nearly bursts through her hands but stays in.
Commentary.Howout: c Pooja Vastrakar b Deepti Sharma

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR LEG BYES! That spoils the over! Not a good ball to end. On the pads, Mooney looks to work it on the leg side but misses. It hits the pad and races away fine to the fine leg fence.
Outside off, Perry guides it down to third man and takes one.
Slightly shorter and outside off, Perry looks to cut but underedges it to point.
Shorter and on off, this is slapped towards cover for one.
Drop and run! On off, Perry plays it towards cover for one.
Brilliant fielding! Outside off, Perry guides it through backward point. Pandey from third man, covers a lot of ground to her right, dives and saves two for her side. Brilliant one-handed stop.
Tossed up, around off. Perry skips down the track and pushes it to long off for a single. Just 4 runs of Sharma's first.
Full and on off. Perry plays it back to the bowler.
Full and outside off. Mooney gets low and sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up, on middle. Perry works it to long on for a single.
On off, pushed to mid off for a single.
Flighted and on off. Mooney plays it to the right of the bowler. Sharma dives and makes a half stop.
Good length and outside off. The ball moves away. Perry leaves it alone. A good over for Vastrakar. 2 runs and a wicket off it.
Short and outside off. Perry hangs back and cuts it to point.
A length ball, on middle. Perry works it through mid-wicket for a couple.
Ellyse Perry walks out to bat now!

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! India is really enjoying its time with the ball here. Now, Pooja Vastrakar gets into the wicket's column. On a length, outside off. Ashleigh Gardner looks to go for the booming drive. The ball shapes away, takes the faintest of outside edge. Richa Ghosh pouches it comfortably. The players put in an appeal and the umpire raises her finger in a flash. Gardner has to go back early.
Commentary.Howout: c Richa Ghosh b Pooja Vastrakar

Commentary.Commentary: Good length and on off. Gardner pushes it to mid off.
A length ball, on off. Gardner defends it to mid off. Shafali Verma dives to her right to make a sharp stop.
Short and outside off, Gardner cuts it through cover for a single. An eventful over for Australia Women. 14 runs coming off it.
Outside off, Gardner pushes it to cover.
On the pads, tucked to fine leg for a single.
FOUR! And Again! Mooney is on a roll. Short and down leg. Mooney hangs back and hits it through square leg for another boundary.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries. Short and on off. Mooney hangs back and pulls it through mid-wicket for another boundary.
FOUR! Short and punished. Short and on off. Mooney hangs back and pulls it through square leg for a boundary.
Ashleigh Gardner walks out now.

OUT! SHE INDEED HAS HIT HER OWN STUMPS! Meg Lanning is distraught. She can't believe what has she just done. She had actually hit that for a boundary. This is probably the worst way to be dismissed. It is short and outside off. Meg Lanning plays it late, She does get it past point but the stumps are disturbed. Ghosh puts in an appeal and Lanning starts walking back. It is taken upstairs. Time for the replays and they show that she has hit her stumps. Huge wicket in a fortunate manner, India won't care though.
Has Meg Lanning hit her own stumps? She is already walking off, this could well be the luck India needed. It is referred.
FOUR! Nicely played. Tossed up, around middle. Lanning gets low and hits it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Flighted full and on off. Mooney skips down the track and works it to long on for a single.
Short and on off. Mooney pulls it to mid-wicket.
Floated and on off. Lanning pushes it to mid off for a single.
Loopy ball, outside off. Lanning prods and looks to defend it but misses.
Brilliant from Jemimah Rodrigues in the field. A full-length ball, outside off. Mooney slashes it through cover. Jemimah Rodrigues dives to her right to make a sharp stop.
Full-length ball, on off. Lanning plays it late and guides it towards third man. They take one.
FOUR! Sheer timing! Length ball, outside off. Lanning stands tall and carves it through cover for a boundary.
Good length and outside off. Mooney guides it towards third man for a single.
Length and on the pads yet again. Lanning flicks it to short fine leg for a single.
A length ball, on the pads. Lanning defends it to the leg side.
FOUR! Nice and fine! Deft touch and that spoils the over somewhat! Outside off, flatter, Mooney plays it late and down to the third man fence.
Misfield and another run! Outside off, Lanning drives, the fielder at covers, dives to her left and makes a half stop. A single.
That made a lovely sound of the bat! Outside off, this is swept through square leg for one.
Floats it up on off, Lanning looks to defend, this one goes off the outer half to point for one.
Nicely tossed up on off, defended.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Rajeshwari Gayakwad comes into the attack now. She replaces Shikha Pandey.

Ends the over well! Good fielding! One of the rare good moments for India in the field in this series. Fuller and on off, this is driven, Pooja Vastrakar at covers dives to her right and keeps it down to one.
Just the two from the over with a ball to go! Outside off, Mooney looks to drag it over long on but it goes off the inner half to mid-wicket.
On off, this is guided to point. Another dot.
Edgy run! Length and on off, Lanning looks to defend but this goes off the outside edge down to third man for one. She is off the mark.
Slightly shorter and around off, this is guided to point.
Outside off, Mooney guides it to point for one.
13 from Pandey's second then. On the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.

FOUR! Just short and a boundary! Three in a row and the momentum now seems to be shifting. Renuka should have done better there. On the pads, this is worked towards deep backward square leg. Renuka runs to her right, it lands in front of her but she fails to stop it.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries for Mooney! Welcome ones for Australia. This time off the front foot. This is fuller and on off, it is timed through covers. Races away to the fence.
FOUR! Finds the gap beautifully! Mooney makes room, this is a length ball outside off. She times it past the diving point fielder and into the fence.
Back of a length and on off, shapes away. Beth pushes it to covers. Really good from the Indians so far.
Fuller and on middle, Mooney works it to mid-wicket.
A dot to end a successful over! Length and on off, Lanning guides it to point.
Who will walk out now?

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! There is the big wicket of Healy! It is yet another low score for her and that is a wonderful comeback from Renuka. Also, credit to Ghosh who has taken a superb catch. She was upto the stumps. Renuka bowls it on a length and outside off. Healy pushes at it tentatively away from the body. It takes the outside edge, hits the glove of Richa Ghosh and lobs up in the air, she shows good presence of mind, keeps her eyes on the ball and takes it on the second attempt. Early wicket for India and they are ecstatic.
Commentary.Howout: c Richa Ghosh b Renuka Singh

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Poor ball and all the pressure that was building on Healy is let off! Short and well wide outside off, it is slapped through covers for a boundary.
A quick run to get things going for Australia and Mooney! Length and on off, this is pushed to cover for one.
Another appeal but not given! Slightly shorter, this one pitches outside leg. Mooney looks to pull but misses. An appeal but turned down.
Renuka starts well also! Good length and on off, defended.
Who will bowl from the other end? Renuka Singh it is.
Brilliant start from Pandey! A maiden! On off, Healy pushes it to mid off.
A huge appeal but turned down! The impact seems outside off. Length yet again, it lands and jags back in sharply. Healy looks to defend but misses to get hit on the front pad.
On the fuller side this time, Healy plays it with the full face of the bat to mid off. Good from India, Ghosh has come upto the stumps, that will stop Healy from walking out.
Good length again and outside off, Healy shuffles right across to cover that inswing and blocks it to covers. Good start by Pandey.
Nice movement again! Fuller this time, it starts outside off and comes back in. Healy works it to mid on.
Really good start by Pandey! Length and outside off, it jags back in. Healy looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
The game is set to begin. India Women players stride out to the middle. Followed by Alyssa Healy and Beth Mooney who come out to bat for Australia Women. Shikha Pandey to start with the ball.

Meg Lanning, the captain of Australia Women, is up for a chat. She says they wanted to bat anyways and she is excited to finish the series off on a high. Ends by saying Annabel Sutherland comes in place of Hannah Darlington.

Harmanpreet Kaur, the skipper of India Women, is up for a chat. She says they want to bowl first. Adds that is what they wanted to do from day 1 and they have got it. Adds that there is one change Harleen Deol comes in for Yastika Bhatia.

Australia Women (Playing XI) -  Alyssa Healy (WK), Beth Mooney, Meg Lanning (C), Ashleigh Gardner, Ellyse Perry, Tahlia McGrath, Nicola Carey, Sophie Molineux, Georgia Wareham, Annabel Sutherland (In for Hannah Darlington), Tayla Vlaeminck.

India Women (Playing XI) - Shafali Verma, Smriti Mandhana, Jemimah Rodrigues, Harmanpreet Kaur (C), Harleen Deol (In for Yastika Bhatia), Richa Ghosh (WK), Pooja Vastrakar, Deepti Sharma, Shikha Pandey, Rajeshwari Gayakwad, Renuka Singh.
TOSS - The coin goes up and lands in favour of India Women. They have opted to bowl first.

The multi-former series has been sealed by the Aussies (9-5) with a hard fought win in the last game. However, the last game is by no means a dead rubber. Australia would love to win the T20I series 2-0 whereas India would want to end the tour on a high. Can they do so? We will find out. Toss and teams in a bit.
... MATCH DAY ...
